pet: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for FLYZRDS, Wizard Lizard Flies. Generate a square 1024x1024 PNG with genuinely transparent background, exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows of equally sized cells (16 separated character sprites, 256x256 source cells). NO grid lines, NO text, NO labels, NO floor, NO background. One consistent original adorable mint-green chibi LONG-NECK DINOSAUR wizard with large head, long neck, small rounded body, stubby legs, big expressive eyes, crooked purple wizard hat with gold band, tiny purple cape, small magical staff. Side view facing RIGHT in all cells. Crisp 16-bit pixel art with hard square pixel edges and a limited palette: dark violet outline, mint greens, cream, purple, gold. Same character, size and proportions across poses. Each complete sprite entirely inside its cell with generous transparent padding (at least 24px), feet baseline at 224px within each cell. Do not crop hats, tails, staff, effects. Exactly these poses in row-major order: row1 columns1-2 idle standing then blink, columns3-4 two opposite walking leg poses; row2 columns1-2 eating berries head lowered then chewing, columns3-4 playful reaching then happy toy pose; row3 columns1-2 curled asleep eyes closed with hat still on, columns3-4 casting with staff raised then small spark; row4 columns1-2 ward casting small golden magical shield then shield shimmer, columns3-4 celebration arms up then happy bounce. Use modest contained effects inside safe cell margins. Deliver clean reusable sprites, not a poster or UI mockup.
props: Use case: stylized-concept. Production GAME PROP SPRITE SHEET for FLYZRDS, original 16-bit chibi wizard dinosaur garden. Square PNG genuinely transparent background. Exactly 4 columns x 4 rows of isolated evenly spaced props in equal square cells. NO text, no gridlines, no labels, no background scene. Crisp pixel art, dark violet outlines, limited mint green/purple/cream/gold palette with berry coral accents. Each prop centered with 15 percent clear padding, all silhouettes disconnected. Row1 left-to-right: a little bowl of red berries; a gold star on a purple toy ball; a cozy mint-and-straw nest; a pale mint egg with purple speckles. Row2: a square lush grass ground tile; a square dark earthy garden path tile; a chunky purple toadstool; a violet rune stone with mint glowing rune. Row3: a small golden spell spark; a violet-and-gold magical shield effect; a mint healing blossom spell effect; a gold four-point twinkle. Row4: a compact berry feed UI icon; a gold star play UI icon; a crescent moon sleep UI icon; a tiny magical garden hut habitat UI icon. Cute readable silhouettes that downscale well to 32x32 game sprites. Consistent pixel scale; no realistic textures or smooth gradients. Ground tile cells can be opaque squares but maintain clear margins. Other objects truly transparent outside shapes. Do not crop any silhouette.
